text: Why choose to study this program? The joint MBA program between NBU and UC was started in 2001 upon the approval of the Ministry of Education of China. It is the only Chinese-foreign joint MBA program in Zhejiang Province, China. The program aims to train senior managerial professionals equipped with sound business management knowledge and capabilities as well as an international vision and pioneering spirit. Up to now, several hundreds of advanced managerial professionals have graduated from this program and been well recognized in the local society. NBU-UC MBA is a thriving and competitive brand in China. Diploma Awarded UC MBA degree Note: Only Bachelor degree holders are eligible to apply for NBU degree and required to complete 4 more courses besides the above 12. UC MBA Degree 1. Students of non-English speaking countries meeting both of the following requirements can obtain the normal (standard) UC MBA degree, which is the same as that delivered on UC Australian campus: (a) Achieve a result of IELTS 6.0 at least, or pass the UC English Language Test (3 chances at most) before the start of the second year. (b) Successfully complete all the units of the MBA. 2. Students who do not satisfy the requirement for English proficiency but pass all the units, shall be awarded the UC MBA degree with an extra sentence on it- “Taught in English and Chinese”. Academic Semesters Students in this program will spend 2 years in Ningbo university, while each year is divided into 2 semesters. First semester: from Sep to Jan, Second semester: from Feb to Jun.
